notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
Bugfixes:
[list]
[*]Galleries now work as intended. The fix is applied automatically before entering the main menu.
[*]Diana is revealed automatically if you visited Amber in any playthrough. The fix is applied at the same phase as the gallery fix.
[*]The skip transitions button in the settings is now shown properly.
[/list]

Happy New Year!

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
Another go to fix rare "Arguments supplied, but parameter list not present" errors. 

We tried to keep those saves playable by providing a set of instructions what to do if the save was made right after a scene belonging to a gallery item had ended.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content: Bugfix for the error appearing after a save was loaded.
